integrity: All quantitative estimates follow from explicitly stated radial-moment inequalities, with changed exponential scales checked analytically. No numerical samples are used to infer an infinite limit.
scientific_limitations: Lower logarithmic separation is subsequential at an infinite-type boundary point; finite regularity C^m but not C^(m+1), and no smoothly bounded endpoint claim. Novelty comparison constrained to inspected sources; independent verification not performed.
title: Critical logarithmic Bergman–Szegő separation on finitely smooth Hartogs domains
